text: Resonance Chief Drenn Korvath serves as First Chief of the Vorran Clan Council within the vorran_clans faction.
Zero-Sum Clan Calculus — Every Gain by Another is a Loss to the Vorran; Honor Demands Open Contest
Declared three contested systems as Vorran Clan sovereign, Led resonance-ritual validation of new warriors, Rebuffed GU envoy at Clan Council
Distrustful of Zylox (views GU expansion as clan-territory encroachment); reluctant tactical awareness of Torr-Kai as territorial buffer
